upstream.bytesSource: git cat-file committed blobs; worktree is never read

snapshot.policy: Every regular tracked blob, original relative paths/bytes/canonical Git modes; symlinks/gitlinks explicitly excluded. No .git or untracked runtime/user files.
snapshot.runtimeUse: Forbidden: ignored local adaptation input only; no imports, workspace membership, packaging or production execution.
snapshot.closure: Whole regular tracked tree is a conservative source/resource/test superset, not a claimed AST-minimal closure. Static/type/dynamic imports, createRequire, import.meta resources, styles, workers and fixtures retain all tracked targets. Generated/untracked outputs and external dependencies remain described by committed scripts/manifests/lock; nothing is installed or fetched.
snapshot.computedPaths: Whole tracked tree retained for computed resources; host absolute paths, user HOME, databases, runtime sessions and generated/external assets are not copied or resolved.
snapshot.modePolicy: Exact canonical 0644/0755 for created and checked regular files. Existing conflicts, extra files, symlinks/nonregular entries rejected; no overwrite/chmod of existing files.

provenance.comparison: Point-in-time existing vendor bytes plus recorded newer upstream originals/patches; this tool never changes or continuously validates production. Every input remains source-reference-only until explicitly adapted. Identical files preserve existing production; differing files require explicit merge, never downgrade.

usage.adaptation: Read originals under snapshot.path/<original path>; copy/extract only into assigned in-repository production paths after parent acceptance. Keep snapshot immutable. Reuse identical newer vendor; explicitly merge differences and retain PM authorization/persistence. Never import .ref or the external checkout at runtime.
